tytul: Head cheese in jars: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for head cheese, a pressed mass of pork offal in meat jelly, made in jars (Polish salceson). [T:-] This card covers the version made in jars, and JarAtlas also has no recipe for the traditional simmered version, including one made in a ham press. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning. [T:SZY-006]
NCHFP recommends canning low-acid foods, and tomatoes and tomato products, only according to the procedures in the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning. [T:SZY-007]

akapity: JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canning head cheese from a checked source. [T:-]
